name: Uchi Technologies Berhad
summary: Uchi Technologies Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of electronic control systems in Switzerland, Portugal, Germany, the United Kingdom, China, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through Manufacturing and Trading segments. It provides configurable presence and distance-sensing time-of-flight modules, touch-screen advanced displays, high-precision light measurement equipment, and mixed signal control systems for centrifuge or laboratory equipment, mixed-signal microprocessor-based applications, and system integration products, as well as electronic modules.
